support_claim: CRM HEL-441 names Helion Robotics Ltd while registry 11847299 names Helion Industrial Systems Ltd, and commercial notes explicitly establish Helion Industrial Systems Ltd as a separate company from the Helion Robotics CRM counterparty.

propositions.proposition: CRM record HEL-441 names the counterparty as Helion Robotics Ltd.
propositions.relevance: Characterizes the left referent (crm:HEL-441) as Helion Robotics Ltd.

propositions.proposition: Registry record 11847299 names the entity as HELION INDUSTRIAL SYSTEMS LTD.
propositions.relevance: Characterizes the right referent (registry:11847299) as HELION INDUSTRIAL SYSTEMS LTD.

propositions.proposition: Helion Robotics Ltd is the operating name used in CRM.
propositions.relevance: Links the CRM operating name to the left referent's recorded name (Helion Robotics Ltd).

propositions.proposition: Invoices and Companies House use Helion Robotics Limited, and that is the same legal entity as Helion Robotics Ltd.
propositions.relevance: Establishes identity between Helion Robotics Ltd (CRM name) and Helion Robotics Limited (legal/registry-facing name), but does not link either to registry:11847299.

propositions.proposition: Helion Industrial Systems Ltd is a different company.
propositions.relevance: Explicitly states that Helion Industrial Systems Ltd (the name on registry:11847299) is not the same company as the Helion Robotics entity associated with CRM.

propositions.proposition: Helion Industrial Systems Ltd sold sensors in 2018 and has no current MSA.
propositions.relevance: Separates Helion Industrial Systems Ltd (registry:11847299) as a distinct historical vendor with no ongoing master services agreement, supporting distinctness from the active CRM counterparty HEL-441.
